topic: Theory: Joy Boy's unkept promise to the fish-men is finished by Luffy, Jinbe and Shirahoshi (Poseidon steering Noah)
title: Shirahoshi And Jinbe Finish Joy Boy's Broken Promise
description:
Joy Boy left an apology on a Poneglyph beside Fish-Man Island, and Noah, the ship built to carry the sea people to the surface, has been waiting ever since. This theory argues that Luffy, Jinbe and Shirahoshi, the current Poseidon, are the three people set up to keep that promise, using Fisher Tiger's story, Jinbe's transfusion for Luffy and the way Noah was stopped.

Do you think Noah is a ship for the fish-men or a weapon against the Red Line? Tell me which side you're on.
